title: Reject bare generic templates for unlisted venues
description: Adds a venue-agnostic fallback gate while retaining stronger declarative checks for known venues.
changes: Keep class and style-marker checks for known venues.
For every other named venue, reject a bare generic document class without a local author-kit style.
Allow custom official classes and local style-based templates to proceed to normal compilation checks.

rollback.notes: Remove the generic fallback gate and retain only known venue rules.
